<a id="game_screen"></a>
### [`game_screen`](../../../src/game_screen.asm#L9) `$8C00-$8FF7`

*variable*

Screen RAM ($8C00-$8FE7, 40x25) of the title and the game; the image bytes (leftover symbol text) do not matter. Game layout: row 0 empty, row 1 status line ("1UP 000000 TOP 000000 FALLS 04"), row 2 separator, rows 3-24 the room (11 tile rows of 2 screen rows). $8FE8-$8FF7 are spare; the room decoder writes 2 bytes there for rooms 4, 7, 10, 13, 17, 18.

<a id="sprite_pointers"></a>
### [`sprite_pointers`](../../../src/game_screen.asm#L135) `$8FF8-$8FFF`

*variable*

Sprite pointers 0-7 (block number = address/64 - $200). Sprites 0-4 show the actor buffers ($06-$0A or $0B-$0F, written by show_actor_sprites); in room 18 sprites 6 and 7 get $0D/$0E from launch_fireball0/launch_fireball1; the title uses block $0F for the TM sprite.
